long_biography.plain_text:
Coyle Personnel began recruiting workers for the construction industry in 1988, before widening its remit across a dozen specialist fields. Kevin Coyle has directed the company for more than three decades, developing a nationwide staffing platform that covers temporary, permanent and contract placements.

His expansion also included Mayday Healthcare, established in 2003 as a specialist medical-staffing company. Outside the businesses, Coyle supported his former school, St James' Catholic High School in Barnet, with a donation that funded a minibus for pupils' sport and activities. The minibus enabled pupils to pursue outings and activities that the school had previously postponed.
